== Notes ==
* The energy gain ''does'' trigger upon the death of the hexed foe.
*If you cast this skill on a target which an ally has already put Kitah's Burden on, you will gain two [[packet]]s of energy. One for when theirs would have normally ended, and one when yours ends

== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after the [[Canthan Heroes|Canthan hero]], [[Kitah]].
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Kitah's Burden/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
